item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from shutil import copy2
from openpyxl import load_workbook
from openpyxl.chart import BarChart, Reference
from openpyxl.chart.label import DataLabelList

path = Path('/home/user/WeeklySales.xlsx')
backup = path.with_suffix('.before_chart.xlsx')
if not backup.exists():
    copy2(path, backup)

wb = load_workbook(path)
# Remove existing Sheet2 so the requested sheet has clean contents/chart.
if 'Sheet2' in wb.sheetnames:
    ws_old = wb['Sheet2']
    wb.remove(ws_old)

ws1 = wb['Sheet1'] if 'Sheet1' in wb.sheetnames else wb[wb.sheetnames[0]]
ws2 = wb.create_sheet('Sheet2')

for row in ws1.iter_rows(min_row=1, max_row=11, min_col=1, max_col=3):
    for cell in row:
        ws2[cell.coordinate].value = cell.value

ws2.column_dimensions['A'].width = 12
ws2.column_dimensions['B'].width = 12
ws2.column_dimensions['C'].width = 12

chart = BarChart()
chart.type = 'col'
chart.style = 10
chart.grouping = 'clustered'
chart.overlap = 0
chart.title = 'Sales & COGS'
chart.y_axis.title = 'Amount'
chart.x_axis.title = 'Week'
chart.height = 9
chart.width = 16

data = Reference(ws2, min_col=2, max_col=3, min_row=1, max_row=11)
cats = Reference(ws2, min_col=1, min_row=2, max_row=11)
chart.add_data(data, titles_from_data=True)
chart.set_categories(cats)
chart.legend.position = 'r'

ws2.add_chart(chart, 'E2')
wb.active = wb.sheetnames.index('Sheet2')
wb.save(path)
print('updated', path)
print('sheets', wb.sheetnames)
PY"
